description.en: A list of API security risk IDs.

description.zh:
混合云集群 ID。
> 只针对混合云场景，您可以调用[DescribeHybridCloudClusters](~~2849376~~)获取混合云集群信息。
description.en:
The ID of the hybrid cloud cluster.

> This parameter is available only for hybrid cloud scenarios. Call the [DescribeHybridCloudClusters](~~2849376~~) operation to query information about hybrid cloud clusters.

description.zh:
WAF实例的ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)查询当前WAF实例的ID。
description.en:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

> Call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the ID of the WAF instance.
The remarks for the status change.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: a region outside the Chinese mainland.
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

description.zh:
风险状态。取值：

- **toBeConfirmed**：表示待确认。
- **confirmed**：表示已确认。
- **toBeFixed**：表示待修复。
- **fixed**：表示已修复。
- **ignored**：表示忽略。
description.en:
The status of the security risk. Valid values:

- **toBeConfirmed**: The security risk is to be confirmed.

- **confirmed**: The security risk is confirmed.

- **toBeFixed**: The security risk is to be fixed.

- **fixed**: The security risk is fixed.

- **ignored**: The security risk is ignored.

title.zh: 批量修改API安全风险状态

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi modify-apisec-abnormals --instance-id waf_v3prepaid_public_cn-0000 --abnormal-ids a50b820efee0989df3b54b208900000 --user-status fixed --note already_fixed. --cluster-id 428 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
